column5: TypeEnum name-or-ordinal normalization and canonical readback are typed; the full SysVar scope/type validator and warning/error plumbing remain outside this dependency-closed leaf

The oneShotDef/oneShotSet/oneShotUse state, readback, level selection, SetTxnIsolationLevelOneShotStateForNextTxn transition, adjacent TxnReadTS use/peek/set/cleanup value contract, RetryInfo queue metadata, PlanCacheParamList reset/append/index/all-value/privacy-bit contract, and ReadConsistencyLevel strict/weak labels/validation are typed; SessionVars, TxnCtx, timestamp-oracle, SnapshotInfoschema, request isolation, retry orchestration, prepared-plan evaluation, and commit orchestration remain outside these leaves
Isolation-level metadata is extracted from the base provider boundary only; TSO, KV activation, snapshots, failpoints, provider hooks, and storage isolation are intentionally not claimed
